requirements.title: IOSTAT_INQUIRE_INTERNAL_UNIT is assigned for internal-unit INQUIRE status
requirements.definition: IOSTAT_INQUIRE_INTERNAL_UNIT is a default integer scalar constant assigned to an INQUIRE IOSTAT variable upon use of a file-unit-number that identifies an internal unit.

pending.IOSTAT_INQUIRE_INTERNAL_UNIT-default-int: Use USE ISO_FORTRAN_ENV, ONLY: IOSTAT_INQUIRE_INTERNAL_UNIT; assign it to an integer initialized to 777, assert KIND(value)==KIND(0), RANK(value)==0, and mutate the imported name to IOSTAT_END.
pending.IOSTAT_INQUIRE_INTERNAL_UNIT-internal-un: Use a defined formatted output procedure invoked by WRITE(character_buffer,*) on a derived-type value; inside the procedure initialize stat=777, execute INQUIRE(UNIT=unit, IOSTAT=stat), store stat in module state, and assert stat==IOSTAT_INQUIRE_INTERNAL_UNIT after the parent internal WRITE. Mutate the parent transfer to WRITE(OUTPUT_UNIT,*) and require the stored status to differ.
